dialogues.speaker: Little Que'er
dialogues.text: Guhua this, Guhua that... You've never even cared about me... *sob*

dialogues.speaker: Little Que'er
dialogues.text: Who are you? Do I know you?

dialogues.speaker: Little Que'er
dialogues.text: Who I am is none of your business! You... I'll bet you're a monster from the mountains disguised as a person to try and trick the two of us!

dialogues.speaker: Little Que'er
dialogues.text: "I"? "I"!? Cat got your tongue? Oh, I knew you were bad news!

dialogues.speaker: Little Que'er
dialogues.text: You're just lucky my senior is here, otherwise I'd slice you open and give your soul an out-of-body experience otherwise!

dialogues.speaker: Little Que'er
dialogues.text: MY senior. MINE! Who are YOU calling senior!?

dialogues.speaker: Little Que'er
dialogues.text: We have come here to seek guidance from the adeptus on how to revive the Guhua Clan. I'm warning you, do not get in our way!

dialogues.speaker: Little Que'er
dialogues.text: And more importantly, keep your filthy hands off my senior!

dialogues.speaker: Little Que'er
dialogues.text: Guhua Clan? What about the Guhua Clan?

dialogues.speaker: Little Que'er
dialogues.text: Hmph... My senior is the same, Guhua this, Guhua that... All he ever thinks about is the Guhua Clan.

dialogues.speaker: Little Que'er
dialogues.text: Without seeming to notice that barely anyone else apart from us still associates themselves with that archonforsaken martial arts club...

dialogues.speaker: Little Que'er
dialogues.text: If he could show even a fraction of the same affection he has for Guhua to me, maybe...

dialogues.speaker: Little Que'er
dialogues.text: Yeah, that's right! Stop distracting us already!
